    faq

    Your questions, our answers.

    Does it Fit as a Carry-On?

    Yes! We've specifically designed the bag to fit as a carry-on on all airlines.

    Here's a list of some common airlines that we've verified the bag works for as a carry-on

    • Spirit Airlines
    • United Airlines
    • Frontier Airlines
    • American Airlines
    • Delta Airlines
    • Southwest Airlines
    • Alaska Airlines
    • Hawaiian Airlines
    • Skywest Airlines
    • British Airways
    • Air France
    • Air Canada
    • Allegiant Air
    • Lufthansa
    • Norwegian Airlines
    • Emirates
    • Qatar Airways
    • Japan Airlines

    There's too many airlines to list them all, but if you'd like to check if the Luhxe Travel Bag works for your specific airline, email us at support@luhxe.com

    How Do Returns Work?

    We stand behind every Luhxe Travel Bag. If anything's not right, our 100-Day Guarantee has you covered — just reach us through luhxe.com/contact and we'll make it right. We respond personally within 24 hours.

    How Much Clothing Can I Pack?

    You can comfortably pack up to 10 days' worth of everyday clothing, along with 2 to 3 wrinkle-free dresses, ensuring you're prepared for extended stays or varied occasions.

    Is It Waterproof?

    Yes, it's crafted with waterproof Nylon-surfaced material, ensuring your belongings stay dry and protected against rain or accidental spills.

    What Is The Bag Made Of?

    Our Travel Bags are made out of super high-fiber PU leather. This is a form of vegan leather that is both sustainable and climate friendly.

    Can this Bag Really Save me Money?

    According to CNBC, the average cost of a check-in bag for a round-trip flight ranges between $85-125 in 2024.

     

    That means by using the Luhxe travel bag (which classifies as a carry-on), you essentially get it for free on the first trip you use it on!

     

    The bag is designed to last for 15-20 years, so if you take 2 trips a year with an average checked bag cost of $100, that's between $3,000 to $4,000 saved!
